dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Presence of two visible horizontal bands; the lower band on the greater coverts is thicker with high grayscale contrast, while the upper band on the median coverts is narrower and lower in contrast.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High boundary sharpness with distinct pale-gray margins along the outer edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers.
